blogs.title: Decoding DPO: How a Simple Cross‑Entropy Trick Beats RLHF
blogs.description: Take a walk through Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and see how it replaces the heavy reinforcement learning loop used in RLHF. Explained with clear analogies, this post shows why a single binary cross‑entropy loss can capture the same preference‑matching objective as PPO and why that means fewer hyperparameters and cheaper training.

blogs.title: From Preferences to Policies: The Theory Behind DPO’s Closed‑Form Solution
blogs.description: Delve into the math that makes DPO possible—how a reward model can instead be expressed directly in terms of the language model policy. Readers will learn about the Bradley‑Terry re‑parameterization, the role of the KL constraint, and how DPO’s change‑of‑variables unlocks exact policy optimisation.

blogs.title: Sentiment Control, Summarization & Dialogue: Real‑World Impact of Direct Preference Optimization
blogs.description: Explore DPO’s empirical results across three NLP tasks. This article highlights the win‑rate curves, temperature robustness, and out‑of‑distribution performance, giving readers a practical sense of when and how to apply DPO to their own applications.

blogs.title: Why DPO Is “Alone” in Alignment Research—And What That Means for Future Models
blogs.description: Beyond the algorithm itself, discuss how DPO opens the door to scaling alignment research without RL. Topics include potential for self‑labeling, pitfalls in over‑optimising rewards, and prospects for applying DPO to larger models or other modalities.
